description: 5th-order Stokes waves (H 0.3 m, T 4 s, h 5 m) on a following current (B 514, U 1 m/s, spin-up 30 s) with Doppler (B 530 2 10): iowave re-solves k from the linear Doppler relation, the Stokes library refines it with its own 5th-order dispersion relation (omega = k (c_E + U_n)) and recomputes its coefficients; Riemann edges, generation zone and beach with the background.
